title: My Love
desc: Raj, a man from a wealthy family, decides if he should marry the daughter of his father's best friend or follows the path of his true love.

title: Kudrat
desc: Chandramukhi visits Shimla and learns that she is a reincarnation of Paro, a girl who was raped and murdered. Plagued by her dark past, she attempts to bring the culprits to justice.

title: Mazdoor
desc: Dinanath is a foreman in a textile mill who dreams of one day running his own mill more fairly. He leaves the mill after upsetting the management by supporting his mistreated co-workers. With the support and inspiration of a young orphan, Ashok, he has taken in, Dinanath raises the money to buy a property, leading to the eventual realization of his dream. Then Smita enters the picture and everything starts to go wrong.

title: The Don
desc: The story of a common man, who later becomes a Don, who always stands for justice and poor against all odds and evil minds.
